summary: Comprehensive testing of CarbonTraceAI platform after branding updates. All backend API endpoints and frontend UI components are fully functional. Authentication, navigation, dashboard, invoice upload (single and batch), carbon ledger, ESG reports, and responsive design all working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend API Health Check - All endpoints healthy
User Registration API - Creates user and default organization
User Login API - JWT token generation working
Get Current User API - Returns authenticated user info
Get Organizations API - Returns user's organizations
Dashboard API - Returns stats, charts, and timeline data
Get Invoices API - Returns list of invoices
Single Invoice Upload API - AI parsing working with Ollama kimi-k2.5:cloud
Batch Invoice Upload API - Multiple files processed with aggregated emissions
Get Emission Records API - Returns all emission records
Get ESG Frameworks API - Returns ISSB, TCFD, GRI, CBAM frameworks
Frontend Login Page - New logo displayed, correct branding
Frontend Register Page - Registration flow working
Frontend Dashboard - Stats cards, charts, scope breakdown displayed
Frontend Invoice Parser - Upload zone, country selector working
Frontend Carbon Ledger - Record display, verification UI working
Frontend ESG Reports - Form elements, framework selector working
Frontend Navigation - All sidebar links functional
Frontend Branding - 'Made with Emergent' badge removed
Frontend Tab Title - Shows 'CarbonTraceAI'
Mobile Responsive - Login, dashboard, menu, invoices pages responsive
critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes properly implemented for UI testing
Proper error handling in both frontend and backend
MongoDB _id excluded correctly from API responses
Environment variables used correctly for API URL and Ollama configuration

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All UI components functional and properly styled
